descriptionChirho: A Hebrew proper noun (אֱלִיעֶזֶר) meaning 'my God is help', referring to several biblical figures: Abraham's servant/steward from Damascus, a son of Moses, a prophet who spoke against Jehoshaphat's alliance, and various post-exilic individuals. Rendered as 'Eliezer' (eng/spa), 'एलीएजेर' (hin), 'أَلِيعَزَرُ' (arb), '엘리에셀' (kor), 'Eliezeri' (swa). The two clusters differ only in grammatical prefixes (conjunction/preposition ל), not in referential meaning.
